**✨ Feature release** · Obsidian 1.11.4+ · desktop & mobile

AXXA now remembers everything said in a conversation, including the notes that went with each message, even after you reopen it. Long chats no longer get stuck at the model's limit, and every provider's prompt cache is used, so the history you resend costs a fraction of the price. You can also copy your own messages.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **The chat remembers**: the notes found in your vault and the notes you attach now stay with the message they were sent with.
  - The model sees them again on every later turn, not just once. In Agent mode, attached notes now reach the model at all.
  - They are saved in the chat file, so a reopened chat remembers them too.
  - An agent run that stopped with an error is kept, so the chat doesn't forget the notes it already created or edited.
- **Long chats keep going**: when a chat nears the model's context window, its start is summarized by the same model.
  - The model then gets the summary plus the recent messages in full. You still see the whole chat, with a divider you can open to read the summary.
  - If a provider still refuses a request as too long, AXXA learns the real limit from the error, summarizes more and retries once.
  - Before, a chat past the limit failed on every turn. Ollama, which doesn't warn, silently dropped the start of the prompt, including the instructions.
- **Prompt caching on every provider**: the part of the request that repeats turn after turn is read from the provider's cache. A cache read usually costs about a tenth of the normal input price.
  - Anthropic caches only when asked, and AXXA never asked. Now it does.
  - OpenAI and OpenRouter get a key per chat, so each chat's requests reach the server that holds its cache.
  - Ollama: a shorter request between turns no longer changes the context size, which made Ollama reload the model and drop its cache.
- **A context meter**: a small ring next to the model name shows how much of the context window the chat uses. It turns orange at 80%, when the next turn summarizes the start. Tap it for the details, including how much came from the cache.
- **Copy your messages**: a copy button under your own messages, and a Copy button under each answer. Text in the chat can now be selected.

### 🔧 Improvements
- **Usage counts the cache**: cached tokens are measured, priced at the cache rate, and Usage shows what the cache saved you. Prices were checked against each provider's current list.
- **Ollama's model list** shows only the models your Ollama has installed.

### 🐛 Fixes
- **Agent mode on GPT-5.4 and later** works again. It failed on its first request.
- **Gemini usage** is no longer counted several times per answer.
- **"Approve all"** given to an edit no longer approves web requests too.
- **Chat cards** show plain text instead of raw markdown.

### ⚠️ Compatibility
- Reload Obsidian after updating. Settings and saved chats migrate automatically.
- Chats saved by this version open fine in older versions, which ignore the saved context and summaries.
- Summarizing a long chat is one extra request to the same model, counted in Usage like any other.
